TASK 1 â€” Copilot conversation BODY. app-gui, new, ~P2. In-flight Copilot tickets (T-BL38 context bar, T-BL39 attribution) touch only the INPUT ROW; the message body users read is untouched. Scope: streaming/partial output, per-message copy, error-state rendering, auto-scroll+scroll-lock, code/artifact blocks. Coordinate w/ T-BL38/39.

TASK 2 â€” Persistence + undo/redo for new UI toggles. app-gui, fix, ~P3, depends_on T-BL41+T-BL42. Toggles are session-only, no undo. Scope: persist across save/reload (BL41 glyph visibility, BL42 absorbed-sketch eye-toggle); undo/redo for BL41 relation-delete + BL42 tree-absorption.

TASK 3 â€” Sim result VISUALIZATION in GUI. simulation(+app-gui), new, ~P3. Sim tickets (BL04/16/17/18, BL20) return JSON only; users expect to SEE results. Scope: viewport colormap contours (stress/fatigue/thermal/buckling), spectrum plot for FRA/vibration (BL17), toggle+legend.

HOLD â€” do NOT cut yet (need sim-core owner scoping first): (a) Multibody DYNAMICS â€” loads on moving mechanisms; BL16 is kinematics-only by design. (b) Thermo-mechanical COUPLING (thermal-stress) â€” BL04 thermal + structural; coupled-field solve = architecture decision.
